capabilities: Rewrite selected text with preset or custom AI actions, with undo and a word-level edit journal
Chat with a language model in the right sidebar, with streaming, costs, and save-to-note
Attach images and PDFs to questions, extracting the PDF text layer
Connect to OpenAI-compatible API providers or local servers like Ollama and LM Studio
Let the model edit the note through tool calls shown as cards with an Apply button
extras: The manifest carries the disclaimer that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A Russian-language README exists, and manual installation requires downloading files from a GitHub release.
motivation: The README says it is built for people working from Russia, where providers must be reachable without a VPN and accept Russian payment cards.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, and most AI plugins are chat-centered and assume providers that are hard to reach or pay for from Russia.

relations.evidence: Ollama and LM Studio — a model on your own computer, free and offline.
With LM Studio the answer arrives whole rather than letter by letter
Plus an optional ChatGPT subscription provider on desktop.

summary: AI sidebar chat and in-place rewriting of selected text via preset actions, with providers reachable from Russia and local model servers.
